scripts.dev: yarn db:up && concurrently -k -n server,web,desktop "yarn workspace server dev" "yarn workspace web dev" "yarn workspace desktop dev"
scripts.dev:browser: yarn db:up && concurrently -k -n server,web "yarn workspace server dev" "yarn workspace web dev"
scripts.build: yarn workspace server build && yarn workspace web build && yarn workspace desktop build
scripts.start: yarn db:up && yarn build && concurrently -k -n server,desktop "yarn workspace server start" "yarn workspace desktop start"
scripts.test: yarn db:up && yarn workspace server test
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace server typecheck && yarn workspace web typecheck && yarn workspace desktop typecheck
